questions.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had little interest or joy in doing things?
questions.hi: पिछले 2 हफ्तों में कितनी बार किसी काम में मन नहीं लगा या खुशी नहीं मिली?

questions.en: How often have you felt down, low or hopeless?
questions.hi: कितनी बार उदास, निराश या बेकार महसूस हुआ?

questions.en: How often have you felt nervous, anxious or on edge?
questions.hi: कितनी बार घबराहट, बेचैनी या तनाव महसूस हुआ?

questions.en: How often have you been unable to stop or control worrying?
questions.hi: कितनी बार चिंता को रोक नहीं पाए?

questions.en: How often have you had trouble sleeping or felt very tired?
questions.hi: कितनी बार नींद नहीं आई या बहुत थकान रही?
